name: Almond Sponge Cake    Spain Bizcocho De Almendras
instructions: Grind almonds in electric blender or pound in mortar to fine paste
Beat three whole eggs and three yolks with sugar and salt until thick and light yellow
Fold in three egg whites beaten to stiff peak
Gradually sift in flour mixed with ground almonds
Fold no more than necessary to make an evenly blended mixture
Pour into 9-inch loaf pan either lined with wax paper or lightly buttered and sprinkled with flour
Bake 25 to 30 minutes in 375f oven or until toothpick inserted in middle of cake comes out clean
Invert cake over rack or wax paper sprinkled with powdered sugar
If you have used wax paper , cake will come out instantly
Wait until it cools to remove the paper on which it baked
If you have not used wax paper , leave cake inverted in pan until cool
Sprinkle with powdered sugar just before serving
